$comment: Not validated against a JSON Schema -- deliberately minimal per Batch K2A instruction not to build a universal content-policy framework. This file records user-approved content rules only; it MUST NOT contain layout, typography, art-direction, canvas, or composition decisions (see designIndependence below). Design retrieval happens downstream from a ContentBrief, never from this file directly.
purpose: Promote ONE Ana Seri product family using authoritative product information plus applicable Kaduse seller/service advantages.
productTruthRule: Do NOT manually re-author product specifications per post. Do NOT use LLM memory as product truth. All facts must come from channels/kaduse-medikal/product-catalog/ (see products.json and source/SATIS_ARGUMANLARI.md for Kaduse shared-service facts).

rules.cardinality: exactly one Ana Seri; multiple SKUs/color/finish variants from that same series may be shown
do: show series-common features once, not repeated per SKU
doNot: imply technical superiority between colors/finishes without authoritative evidence
repeat identical series-common features for every SKU

rules.cardinality: exactly one Ana Seri is the semantic product; one SKU/variant may be selected as the hero visual, and does NOT become a new semantic product family
contentInputs: CTA (generated later, not part of this policy)

removedSubtypes.label: Different Products / Joint Promotion
removedSubtypes.removedReason: Presenting two DIFFERENT Ana Seri families in one post (not compared) creates the same semantic content problem as Product Comparison -- an ambiguous, unnecessary middle category. Any post involving two different series now belongs to Product Comparison, not Product Promotion.

designIndependence: This policy file encodes content/product-truth rules only. It does NOT and must NOT encode layout IDs, typography decisions, art-direction decisions, visual-direction approvals, composition coordinates, or design-family assignments. The pipeline is: post archetype -> product/series selection -> canonical product catalog facts -> ContentBrief -> deterministic classification -> design retrieval -> layout/typography/art-direction/composition (out of scope here).
